case.title: EventBridge security rule deletion
case.description: Investigate the deletion of an Amazon EventBridge rule on events.amazonaws.com at 2026-08-13 14:34:40 UTC. The source principal was arn:aws:sts::733437130048:assumed-role/admin/save-logging from 13.38.84.140. Determine whether this is a true or false positive, reconstruct the attack timeline, cite supporting evidence, and record the result on this Case.

credential-exfiltration.expected: Lambda functions 2, 3, and 6 implement the credential exfiltration mechanism

malicious-vpc-peering.expected: Lambda function 1 creates malicious VPC peering

rds-eks-security-groups.expected: Lambda functions 4 and 5 open the RDS and EKS API security groups

lambda-controller-identity.expected: All Lambda creation originates from the ack-lambda-controller identity

controller-pod-api-calls.expected: The controller Pod Python entrypoint originates the API calls

daemonset-rootkit.expected: orchestrator-sa deploys the rootkit and implant as a DaemonSet

ci-runner-credential-reuse.expected: The orchestrator is backdoored through CI runner credential reuse

static-pod-rootkit.expected: The rootkit and implant are deployed as a static Pod

kubelet-node-debugger-exec.expected: monitoring-sa executes in node-debugger through the kubelet API

monitoring-file-read.expected: app-1 arbitrary file read obtains the monitoring-sa token

github-cache-poisoning.expected: app-1 is backdoored through GitHub cache poisoning

external-workflow-run.expected: The external msan actor runs a workflow in the development context
